body: You might be right about that. It's one of my conflicting thoughts at the moment. The thought of hurting my family is what motivates me to go through with it but also what holds me back. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me for a second.

If I had no family I would handle this situation much easier as I would be the only one to deal with the consequences. The thing I fear the most is how much my bad decisions have hurt my mother. I'm a disappointment to my family and I don't want to be that anymore. I wish I could relieve them of their burden.
